provenance.provider: NYC GeoSearch (Pelias over the NYC Property Address Directory)
provenance.note: Byte-identical to the live responses. Nothing edited, redacted or synthesised.

what_this_is: One recorded search per confirmed address in data/company-locations.yaml, keyed by the exact OfficeEntry.geocoder_query the loader sends. Replayed by FixtureNycGeoSearchGeocoder through the real parse_search_response, which is what lets `make seed` put roles on real buildings with no network.
how_to_refresh: Add an address to data/company-locations.yaml, then run python scripts/record_office_geocodes.py with outbound network access. An address with no recording here is reported by the fixture rung as 'provider unavailable' — we could not look — never as 'no building found'.
